scripts.check: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -b tsconfig.json && pnpm -F @org/contracts build && pnpm -F @org/web typecheck && pnpm -F @org/components typecheck
scripts.check:all: pnpm lint && pnpm lint:rules && pnpm lint:edges && pnpm lint:architecture && pnpm campaigns:nudge && pnpm check && pnpm test && pnpm -F @org/components build-storybook
scripts.test:integration: TEST_INTEGRATION=true vitest run --project=@org/server && TEST_INTEGRATION=true vitest run --project=@org/legacy-api && TEST_INTEGRATION=true vitest run --project=@org/database
scripts.test:coverage:integration: TEST_INTEGRATION=true vitest run --project=@org/server --coverage --reporter=blob --outputFile.blob=.vitest-reports/integration-server.json && TEST_INTEGRATION=true vitest run --project=@org/legacy-api --coverage --reporter=blob --outputFile.blob=.vitest-reports/integration-legacy-api.json && TEST_INTEGRATION=true vitest run --project=@org/database --coverage --reporter=blob --outputFile.blob=.vitest-reports/integration-database.json
scripts.coverage: pnpm test:coverage:unit && pnpm test:coverage:integration && pnpm coverage:merge
scripts.auth:up: bash scripts/local-only.sh docker compose up -d zitadel
scripts.auth:seed: bash scripts/local-only.sh docker compose --profile seed-zitadel up --abort-on-container-exit seed-zitadel
scripts.auth:down: bash scripts/local-only.sh docker compose stop zitadel
